headings.usage: Used for page titles, category names, product titles on detail pages.

body.usage: Used for product descriptions, reviews, meta info, prices.
body.styles: Highly legible at small sizes, dense layout support.

primary.name: Navy Blue
primary.usage: Global header background, main structural elements.

accent.name: Amazon Orange
accent.usage: Primary CTAs (Add to Cart, Checkout), badges, highlight elements.

background.name: Soft Gray
background.usage: Main page background to contrast with white product cards.

surface.name: White
surface.usage: Product cards, detail sections, checkout forms.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D5D9D9 for structural lines and card boundaries. Sharp or slight roundness (rounded or rounded-md max).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat design mostly. Subtle shadow-sm on hover for product cards.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive text turns darker or adds underline. Buttons slightly darken (e.g., hover:bg-orange-500).
visual_enhancers.textures: None. Keep it flat, clean, and highly functional. Focus on image clarity.

header.style: Solid Navy Blue background (#232F3E) with White text. Do not use transparent background. Includes logo, global search bar, and cart badge.
header.search_bar: White background, clean borders, prominent search icon, category dropdown on the left side.

product_card.style: White background, thin subtle border (border-gray-200), max 4px border-radius. Dense layout.
product_card.content: Image max height 200px (object-contain), Title (2 lines max truncate), Rating stars, Price, Prime-like badge, Add to Cart button.

button.primary: bg-[#FF9900] hover:bg-[#F3A847] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm
button.secondary: bg-[#F7CA00] hover:bg-[#F0C14B] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-[#A2A6AC]

sidebar.style: Used for categories and filters. Compact checkboxes, text-sm, clear hierarchical lists.

grids_and_layouts.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight spacing for high density. p-2 to p-4 for cards. gap-4 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Sidebar on left (filters) + Main content on right (product grid) for listing pages.

motion.philosophy: Utilitarian and fast. No unnecessary animations.
motion.transitions: Fast color transitions on buttons (150ms ease). No heavy scaling or 3D rotations.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Black text on orange is readable. White on Navy is highly readable.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for search buttons, cart icons, and image thumbnails.

images.aspect_ratio: Square (1:1) for product images to maintain grid consistency. Object-contain to prevent cropping.
images.background: White background for product images preferred.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust layout using the provided High-Density Utility Grid strategy. Prioritize functionality, clarity, and density.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` for dropdowns; always use Shadcn UI Select component.
Keep product listings dense. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for cards for maximum control over 1px borders and grid alignments.
Implement a realistic top navigation bar with a solid Navy Blue background. Do NOT make the header transparent.
Buttons should follow pill-shaped (rounded-full) designs with the Amazon Orange accent.
Do NOT use the Inter font. Use Work Sans for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Apply `data-testid` to all clickable elements, forms, and core functionalities for robust testing.
Ensure 'Add to Cart' functionality provides visual feedback via Sonner toast notifications.
Do NOT center align the app container. Ensure standard left-to-right reading flow.
Create a mock checkout flow that simulates real steps (address, payment, order confirmation).
Install icon library: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` or `yarn add lucide-react` for utilitarian ecommerce icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component should be located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.jsx`.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.
Ensure modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons are used based on the exact specifications.
Apply specific transition properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform` instead of `transition-all`.
